describes: packages/plugin/annotation: whole-document hydration, the hydration window, and the document event stream.

cases.name: hydrates-every-page-at-open
cases.covers: The effect subscribes, then kicks listRawAll once: loading until it lands, then one hydrated upsert of every page it has a crop for (a page it does not know is skipped), complete. Reads answer from the model.

cases.name: no-read-grant-means-forbidden
cases.covers: Without doc.annotate.read hydration never asks: the state says forbidden, canRead is false. rehydrate re-checks, but it stores the resolved early-return promise as the running one, so a second rehydrate only flags a re-run and hands the same promise back: nothing is asked again.

cases.name: a-failed-hydration-degrades-to-live
cases.covers: A listRawAll that rejects: remote events queued in the window apply in order, the state is error with the engine error, and live events keep applying. A rehydrate that succeeds re-ingests with bumpAp and completes.

cases.name: the-hydration-window-replays-by-cursor
cases.covers: Remote annotation events during hydration queue, and replay after ingest: serverId <= auditHead is already in the snapshot and drops (the delete-resurrection guard), a newer one applies, one without a serverId applies. Local events and non-annotation events never queue.

cases.name: a-local-engine-replays-everything
cases.covers: A snapshot without auditHead (a local engine) drops nothing it queued, and a string serverId compares as JavaScript does.

cases.name: mixed-type-cursors-compare-as-javascript
cases.covers: A serverId that is not a number compares with a numeric auditHead as JavaScript does: true is 1, a numeric string is its number, a blank one is 0, so each is inside the snapshot and drops. A null auditHead reads as 0.

cases.name: a-null-cursor-reads-as-zero
cases.covers: With auditHead null, a serverId of 0 is inside the snapshot and drops; 1 applies.

cases.name: string-cursors-compare-as-strings
cases.covers: With a string auditHead, string serverIds compare lexicographically.

cases.name: live-remote-events
cases.covers: After hydration, remote events apply at once. A create bumps the appearance epoch, an update bumps only when the engine says the appearance changed, a move never does, a substrate-only annotation (a reply) never does. A delete removes a known id (object number or /NM) and ignores an unknown or empty one. An annotation on a page without a crop is skipped.

cases.name: direct-delivery
cases.covers: deliverRemoteAnnotationEvent applies at once outside a window; an event type it does not know is ignored. Each change is announced with originOf: remote or local by the origin kind, its sessionId as given, its sub (else null) as the actor.

cases.name: records-without-a-ref
cases.covers: A record with no ref cannot be keyed (annotationKey reads ref.kind), so ingesting it throws: a remote event carrying one applies nothing and announces nothing, a moved batch with one in it commits none of the batch, a hydration snapshot with one errors with the TypeError, and a page reload with one keeps only its removal of the stale page.

cases.name: rehydrate-chains-after-the-flight
cases.covers: A rehydrate while one is in flight flags a re-run and returns the running promise; the finally clears it and starts the flagged run, which ingests with bumpAp. The chain settles three turns after its catch, and a stream.desynced event is a rehydrate.

cases.name: page-membership-events
cases.covers: pages.deleted drops the deleted pages’ annotations (nothing when none match); pages.inserted reloads each new page, which is a no-op for a page the layout does not know yet. Both are origin-agnostic.

cases.name: cross-plane-events
cases.covers: redaction.applied reloads each applied page once (skipped results do not); form.valueChanged and form.effectsApplied bump the appearance version of the repainted widgets (object number > 0 only, so a widget numbered 0 keeps its version).

cases.name: reload-page
cases.covers: reloadPage replaces the page’s annotations with a fresh list, leaves other pages alone, keeps the previous view when the list fails, and does nothing for a page without a crop.

cases.name: closing-unsubscribes
cases.covers: The effect’s event subscription is released when the document closes.
cases.reason: Pins that closing releases the event subscription, which engineState's subscriber count shows. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: rotated-page-layout
cases.covers: Ingest reads each page’s own crop: an offset crop moves the content box.
